result.note: Tests the June 2026 replacement of MGNREGA: the cost sharing with states, the 125-day guarantee and the end of the demand-driven design.

questions.prompt: In June 2026, India replaced the MGNREGA rural jobs scheme with a new mission. Consider the following statements about the new mission:
items: It shifts 40% of the scheme's costs to states.
It retains MGNREGA's open-ended, demand-driven character.
It raises guaranteed employment to 125 days.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: Statement 2 is wrong because the new mission ends the open-ended, demand-driven safety net that defined MGNREGA. It does shift 40% of costs to states and raises guaranteed employment to 125 days, so states now carry a much larger share of rural job spending.
questions.source: a new mission shifting 40% of costs to states, raising guaranteed employment to 125 days while ending the open-ended, demand-driven safety net.
